Login fill fixtures

Every page shows lengths and event counts, never a value. Each page asks for #username and #password.

saddlebag fill NAME --field username --selector "#username" --url-contains PAGE
saddlebag fill NAME --field password --selector "#password" --url-contains PAGE
PageWhat it doesWhat it tests
01-keycloak-classicKeycloak classic theme markupThe baseline
02-keycloak-v2Keycloak v2 theme, wrapped inputs and a show-password buttonNested wrappers
03-username-firstUsername, Next, then a password step built in placeFilling across two steps
04-controlled-rerenderReplaces the input on each keystroke and submits from stateFramework state stays in step with the field
05-readonly-until-focusInputs stay read-only until a focus event firesWhether a focus event reaches the page
06-late-renderBuilds the form at 1 s and rebuilds it empty at 2.5 sFilling before the form settles
07-iframeThe form sits in a same-origin iframeTop-frame selector scope
08-shadow-domThe form sits in an open shadow rootShadow DOM selector scope
09-duplicate-idsA hidden form holds the same ids firstSelector landing on a hidden twin
10-wrapper-idThe ids sit on wrapper divs and the inputs carry only a nameThe wrong-element error
11-keystroke-onlyClears any input not preceded by a keydownPages that reject inserted text
